messages:
Aisha R: Quick proposal 1: implement a 'quickclaim + abort tunnel' for inbound leads. Quickclaim gives an instant UI claim (8s TTL) so SDRs see ownership fast; if enrichment or external webhooks don't finish by 6s we preflight an abort tunnel that moves the lead to an overflow queue at 12s. Keeps UX snappy and avoids lost or stuck leads. Thoughts?

Tom B: Love keeping the UX instant. A couple things: how do late HubSpot/SF webhooks interact? And how do we avoid double-assigns when overflow triggers?

Diego S: For late webhooks: reconciler only. If our claim state == "claimed" then external webhooks should be merged into lead fields but not overwrite owner. For RR duplicates: reservation token on quickclaim that expires after 60s. RR ignores reserved entries.

Aisha R: Nice. Timeline summary: on intake -> quickclaim -> enrichment job starts. If enrichment ack <6s attach attributes; if between 6-12s start abort tunnel preflight (reserve overflow slot); if >12s finalize overflow and post message to #sdr-overflow. Also record enrichment_lag and webhook_lag metrics.

ops-bot: enrichment.ping received for lead l_2042 status: queued

Tom B: Add these metrics: inbound.quickclaim.latency_p95, inbound.quickclaim.abort_rate, inbound.quickclaim.late_webhook_merges. Alert if abort_rate > 1% over 5m. Also capture source breakdown (webinar/api/docs).

Diego S: Edge case: duplicate intake from multiple connectors. Use canonical key = email + intake_fingerprint to dedupe before claiming. If duplicate merged during enrichment, prefer fields from the higher enrichment_score and keep earliest claim_ts for ownership.

Aisha R: Ops playbook notes I want included in the PR: commands to force-release a reservation, how to move a lead from overflow back to quickclaim pool, and how to resolve owner conflicts when late merges occur. I'll draft the playbook and attach it to the staging rollout.

Tom B: Implementation snippet idea (store as claim metadata):
```
claim_id: qc_2042
lead_id: l_2042
path: quickclaim
claim_ttl_seconds: 8
reserved_until: 2026-09-01T12:01:30Z
status: reserved|claimed|overflow
```
Reconcilier runs every 10s to merge late webhooks.

Diego S: I'll add metrics and a Grafana dashboard. Also will add an on-call note so SRE can unstick bad reservations.

Aisha R: Action items: Tom -> webhook reconcilier spec + PR; Diego -> metrics + dashboard + on-call note; Isha (me) -> ops playbook + SDR FAQ. Target: feature flag rollout to staging next Wed. :rocket:

Tom B: I'll open the PR and include unit tests for late-webhook reconciliation and duplicate intake merges.

Diego S: ETA for dashboard + alerts EOD Friday.

Aisha R: Thanks all. Will post the playbook draft here when it's ready.
